verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Zapier supports some conditional branching (comm-8 notes it allows 'simultaneous IFs & THENs' vs IFTTT's single condition) but the evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of a dedicated Paths/Filter feature or of parallel branches merging back into a single flow. Multiple community comments (comm-3, comm-11, comm-13) explicitly flag conditional logic and 'escape hatches' as weak points where Zapier breaks down for complex workflows, undercutting confidence in robust branching. Missing for 10: explicit docs on Filters/Paths steps, evidence of parallel-path merge-back, and independent confirmation that branching works reliably at scale.
